text.en: 1. This Direction may be cited as the Consular Conventions (Remission of Fee for Radio Licence) (Revocation) Direction 2005 and shall come into operation on 1st May 2005.
2. The Consular Conventions (Remission of Fee for Radio Licence) Direction (Dir 1) is revoked.
